✨ kvm | TypeScript
🎯 Primary Use Case: Remote management of computers, servers, and workstations, including tasks like OS installation, BIOS adjustments, and general remote control.
✨ Key Features: • Ultra-low Latency (1080p@60FPS, 30-60ms) • H.264 encoding • Free & Optional Remote Access via WebRTC • Optional Tailscale Networking support • Open-source software written in Golang on Linux
📖 Summary: JetKVM is an open-source KVM over IP solution written in Go and TypeScript, designed for high-performance remote computer management. It offers ultra-low latency video and smooth input control, with optional cloud and networking integrations.
